name: Merge Arena: Infinite War
shortDescription: Merge, upgrade, and conquer in this thrilling real-time strategy auto-battler.
fullDescription: Command your army and clash against real players from all over the world in Merge Arena: Infinite War. Combine your units strategically to create a powerful deck and dominate the leaderboards.

name: Monster Princess: Magic Dress Up
shortDescription: Design spooky and glamorous outfits for your very own monster princess.
fullDescription: Unleash your creativity with Monster Princess: Magic Dress Up! Mix and match hundreds of magical clothing items, hairstyles, and accessories to create the ultimate spooky fashion statement.

name: Cute Girl: Fashion Dress Up
shortDescription: Express your unique style and become a fashion icon in this stylish dress-up game.
fullDescription: Step into the world of high fashion with Cute Girl: Fashion Dress Up. Discover the latest trends, design stunning looks, and build your dream wardrobe in this engaging style simulation.
